title: 2027 Flight Software Engineer Intern
content: <h2>Required Qualifications</h2><ul><li>Must be pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.</li><li>Must be returning to school at the end of the internship.</li><li>Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required.</li></ul><h2>Preferred Qualifications</h2><ul><li>Experience using Python or MATLAB for post-flight data analysis is preferred.</li></ul>
